name: Memberra
description: Connect Jellyfin to Memberra for secure customer provisioning, access control, password self-service, server health and playback management.
overview: Memberra gives operators one place to provision, suspend, restore and manage Jellyfin customers; synchronise library access; offer secure password changes; monitor server and playback health; and deliver reliable events to the Memberra platform.

versions.changelog: Securely connects Jellyfin to Memberra with customer provisioning, library access control, suspension, restoration, deletion and password self-service; authoritative user inventory and username management; server health, playback and transcode telemetry; durable outage-safe event delivery; television artwork metadata; and opt-in, audited viewer controls. The plugin cannot run shell commands or arbitrary code.
